name: bank
title: Bank master
description: Bank master. Bank country and key identify the bank; preserve country-specific key formats and deletion status. House banks, house-bank accounts, bank account management and customer/supplier bank details are distinct objects and require their own approved interface/configuration. Do not treat bank master as a bank account balance.
